messages:
elaine: dropping a couple of tiny mocks for the first-run experience — trying a compact cue rail that expands into the full setup checklist. want UX + a11y + eng sanity checks before i push comps.

sam: nice! the compact rail reduces clutter. question: should completion be per-step or a single 'done' CTA at the end?

marta: per-step completion is helpful for telemetry, but we don't want to nag. maybe show progress + let users skip.

oliver: a11y quick note: the proposed CTA color on the rail is ~#5a9bd6 — fails 4.5:1 against white at 14px. need darker or larger text. also keyboard focus outline currently almost invisible.

sam: good catch. i can swap to #0064b2 or bump to 16px for labels. which do we prefer visually?

tariq: darker color is easier to implement. bumping text size impacts layout on very small screens. also, the rail being sticky will overlap the top nav on some breakpoints. we should use position: sticky and a top offset equal to header height.

elaine: sticky is fine as long as it doesn't push content. tariq — can you prototype offset logic?

marta: UX question: persistent quickstart banner vs ephemeral rail. analytics show banners get closed quickly; rails have higher engagement. leaning rail.

oliver: accessibility-wise rail that remains in the DOM and is keyboard-focusable is better than ephemeral banners that only appear briefly. ensure aria-live isn't used for decorative updates.

sam: microcopy tweak suggestion: change "Start with a sample project" -> "Try a sample project". shorter, friendlier. also change "Finish setup" -> "Complete setup" (more actionable).

elaine: agreed on microcopy. add microcopy variants to the A/B test. marta can you own the variant matrix?

marta: yep i'll draft a 3-variant matrix (control, copy variant, persistent-rail variant) and share tomorrow.

tariq: implementation stuff — for the expand animation i'm proposing the following CSS to avoid layout jank:

```css
.cue-rail { position: sticky; top: 64px; transition: transform 180ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; }
.cue-rail--expanded { transform: translateY(0); }
.cue-rail--collapsed { transform: translateY(-4px); opacity: 0.98; }
```

sam: looks good. please keep motion subtle to respect reduced-motion prefs.

tariq: will include `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .cue-rail { transition: none; } }`

oliver: perfect. last a11y nit — when expanding the rail into checklist, focus should move to the first interactive item and there should be a visible focus ring. also add skip link to jump to main canvas.

elaine: great checklist of action items: sam to update comps (contrast + copy), tariq to prototype sticky offset + reduced-motion, oliver to sign off on a11y once implemented, marta to set up A/B variant matrix and telemetry keys. i'll schedule a quick sync Wed 10am.

deploy-bot: reminder: design freeze for onboarding surfaces is Friday 5pm PT.

sam: thanks — i'll aim to upload updated frames by Thu morning. :thumbsup:

marta: i'll put the experiment config into the tracking doc and tag eng.

elaine: awesome team — appreciate the quick checks. leaving this thread open for any last-minute a11y or layout concerns.
